story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 12 — Inner Collections / Westways Recordbook / Sealwright Chamber
hard_outcomes: The party finds an approximately 500-year-old Yahtrean Westways recordbook.
The recordbook contains a less precise but intact regional hand-copy derived from thousands-of-years-old Ancient Diysean Wayfinder information.
Coverage is Westways and central Yahtrea only.
The copy shows the complete Ancient Caelora cluster, a huge northern tower, major routes converging there, and those routes continuing north until the copied region ends.
The copied map does not show the northbound routes' destination and does not identify Ivorybridge.
The existence of an Ancient capital at Caelora is already known; the reveal is scale, intact cluster shape and route relationship.
The Sealwright Chamber separately shows a progression of seal-copying attempts culminating in repeated Crest of Yahtrea copies with powerful magical residue.
Nothing proves any copy reproduced Lysara's genuine royal magical authority.
The seal thread dead-ends in Caelora for now.
The field section ends with a direct cut to Mirena.

true_voice_requirements.nimera: Live brain; strong provenance discipline, self-correction, high/frequent profanity with 15–35% long-form anti-sanitization calibration, no exposition-machine flattening.
true_voice_requirements.torren: Owns route-reading only where the physical map supports it; no certainty beyond the copied region.
true_voice_requirements.ilyra: Dry curiosity/skepticism, no automatic moral/safety role.
true_voice_requirements.cyanis: Crest Knight only; recognizes the relation to the Chapter-1 Wayfinder without becoming Ancient-tech expert.
